desktop.detail: L stair: first floor to roof · 71.75 sq ft clearRepeat the west-then-north L flight above the ground stair. The first-floor approach wraps around the east end to reach the next flight. Proposed roof arrival: 5 × 4 ft landing, enclosed stair head and a 3.5 ft clear timber exit. Roof terrace is one storey above the care-room terrace.
